title: Consecutive Status Run Merger
prompt: Export a generic function collapseStatusLog that takes a chronologically ordered array of { timestamp: number; status: T } entries (where T extends string) and merges consecutive identical statuses into runs shaped { status: T; start: number; end: number; count: number }.
criteria: An empty input array returns [].
Consecutive identical statuses collapse into one run with start equal to the first timestamp, end equal to the last timestamp, and count equal to the merged length.
Non-consecutive repeats (e.g., "up", "down", "up") remain separate runs in order.
The input array is never mutated and the return type preserves a narrow string literal union rather than widening to string.

title: Score Normalizer with Safe Bounds
prompt: Export normalizeScores(values: readonly number[], targetMin?: number, targetMax?: number): number[] that linearly maps finite numbers from their input min–max range into [targetMin, targetMax] (defaulting to 0 and 1).
criteria: An empty array returns [], and an array where all values are equal maps every entry to targetMin instead of producing NaN.
Standard numeric arrays scale proportionally so the minimum maps to targetMin and the maximum maps to targetMax.
Passing NaN, Infinity, or targetMin > targetMax throws a RangeError.

title: Case-Insensitive Header Lookup Map
prompt: Export createHeaderMap(entries?: Iterable<[string, string]>) returning an object with get(name), set(name, value), has(name), delete(name), and toRecord() where header names match case-insensitively while preserving the original casing of the most recent set.
criteria: get("content-type") and has("CONTENT-TYPE") both locate a header stored as "Content-Type".
Overwriting an existing header with different casing replaces the value and updates the key casing returned by toRecord() without creating duplicate keys.
delete(name) removes the header regardless of case and returns true if it existed, false otherwise.

title: Query String Boolean Flag Parser
prompt: Export parseBooleanFlags(query: string): Record<string, boolean> that parses URL query parameters into booleans, treating "true", "1", "yes", and bare flags (e.g., ?debug) as true, and "false", "0", "no" as false.
criteria: Leading ? characters are optional and comparison is case-insensitive (e.g., "TRUE" resolves to true).
Repeated keys use the last valid occurrence in the query string.
Keys with unrecognized values (such as ?mode=fast) are omitted rather than coerced to false.

title: Strict Environment Config Reader
prompt: Export readEnvConfig(env: Record<string, string | undefined>, spec) that reads required and optional string, integer, and boolean settings from a supplied dictionary and returns a typed config object.
criteria: Missing optional keys fall back to their declared default values.
Missing required keys or unparseable integer values (e.g., "12px" or "3.5") throw an Error whose message lists every failing key name.
Empty strings "" for required keys are treated as missing rather than valid values.

title: Fix Shared Mutable Accumulator in Currency Grouper
prompt: Fix a broken groupTransactionsByCurrency(items) utility where reusing a shared default bucket object causes totals from one currency to bleed into another, and floating-point cents drift when summing integer minor units.
must_export: The fixed `groupTransactionsByCurrency(items: Transaction[]): Record<string, Bucket>` plus the `Transaction` and `Bucket` interfaces.
criteria: Each currency code receives its own independent { count: number; totalMinor: number; ids: string[] } bucket.
Calling the function twice with unrelated datasets produces completely isolated results with no cross-call state leakage.
Negative refund amounts decrease totalMinor accurately while still incrementing count.

title: Core Semver Comparator
prompt: Export compareSemverCore(a: string, b: string): -1 | 0 | 1 that compares version strings formatted as MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional leading v.
criteria: Numeric segments compare numerically rather than lexicographically (so "1.10.0" is greater than "1.2.9").
Malformed strings such as "1.2", "1.02.0" (leading zero), or "1.2.x" throw an Error.

title: Discriminated Result Partitioner
prompt: Given type Result<T, E> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: E }, export partitionResults<T, E>(results: readonly Result<T, E>[]) returning { values: T[]; errors: E[] }.
criteria: values contains all unwrapped ok: true payloads in original order and errors contains all ok: false errors in original order.
Falsy payloads (0, "", false, null) are preserved in both arrays.
TypeScript narrows values to T[] and errors to E[] with zero type assertions at the call site.

title: Sparse Hourly Time-Series Gap Filler
prompt: Export fillMissingHours(points: readonly { hourMs: number; value: number }[], fillValue?: number) that takes sorted UTC hour-aligned data points and inserts missing hourly slots between the first and last timestamp.
criteria: Empty or single-point arrays return a shallow copy without throwing.
Missing 3,600,000 ms intervals between the first and last point are filled with fillValue (default 0).
Original point values (including 0 or negative numbers) are never overwritten, and the input array is not mutated.

title: CSV Row Escaper with Formula Neutralization
prompt: Export formatCsvRow(cells: readonly (string | number | boolean | null | undefined)[]) that serializes a single RFC 4180 CSV row and neutralizes spreadsheet formula injection on strings starting with =, +, -, or @.
criteria: null and undefined render as empty fields; strings containing commas, quotes, or newlines are wrapped in double quotes with internal quotes doubled.
String values starting with =, +, -, or @ are prefixed with a single quote ' before quoting.
Actual negative numbers passed as number (such as -42) are serialized as -42 without a leading apostrophe.

title: Fix Broken Type Predicate in Webhook Filter
prompt: Fix a type guard isPaymentWebhook(payload: unknown): payload is PaymentWebhook that currently accepts arrays, null, or missing nested amountCents integers, causing downstream runtime crashes.
criteria: Returns true only when payload is a non-null plain object with type === "payment.settled", a non-empty string id, and a non-negative integer amountCents.
Returns false for null, primitives, arrays, fractional amounts, or negative amounts without throwing.
Narrowing inside an if (isPaymentWebhook(x)) block exposes typed fields without additional casts under strict: true.

title: Stable Multi-Key Record Sorter
prompt: Export sortRecordsByKeys<T>(items: readonly T[], specs: readonly { key: keyof T; direction?: "asc" | "desc" }[]): T[] that sorts records by successive tie-breaker keys for string, number, and boolean properties.
criteria: Returns a new sorted array without mutating items.
Secondary keys break ties when primary keys are equal, honoring independent "asc" and "desc" directions.
Records equal across all specified keys preserve their original relative order.

title: Sliding Window Mean Calculator
prompt: Export movingWindowMean(values: readonly number[], windowSize: number): number[] returning the arithmetic mean for each contiguous window of length windowSize.
criteria: Returns [] when values.length < windowSize.
Throws a RangeError when windowSize is not a positive integer.
Computes exact rolling averages in O(n) time without accumulating floating-point drift on large arrays of identical numbers.

title: Template Variable Interpolator
prompt: Export renderTemplate(template: string, vars: Record<string, string | number>, options?: { strict?: boolean }): string that replaces {{key}} placeholders (allowing inner whitespace like {{ key }}) in a single pass.
criteria: Replaces known keys with their stringified values without recursively re-interpolating replacement values that themselves contain {{...}}.
When strict is true, any missing key throws an Error naming the missing variable.
When strict is omitted or false, unknown placeholders remain untouched in the output.

title: Weekday Schedule Range Expander
prompt: Export expandWeekdaySpec(spec: string): Weekday[] that parses comma-separated tokens like "Mon-Wed,Fri" or wrap-around ranges like "Fri-Mon" into deduplicated weekday names ordered Monday through Sunday.
criteria: Expands normal ranges ("Tue-Thu") and wrap-around ranges ("Sat-Mon" → ["Mon", "Sat", "Sun"]) case-insensitively.
Deduplicates overlapping segments and returns canonical three-letter names sorted Mon–Sun.
Throws an Error on unknown tokens, empty specs, or malformed ranges like "Mon-".

title: Fix Own-Property & Undefined Bug in Key Picker
prompt: Fix pickDefinedKeys<T extends object, K extends keyof T>(source: T, keys: readonly K[]) which currently copies inherited prototype properties and omits legitimate keys whose values are 0 or false.
criteria: Copies only own enumerable properties from source whose value is not undefined.
Retains falsy defined values including 0, "", false, and null.
Never includes inherited prototype properties such as toString even if listed in keys.

title: Hierarchical Breadcrumb Path Builder
prompt: Export buildCategoryPath(nodes: readonly { id: string; parentId: string | null; name: string }[], targetId: string): string[] returning category names from the root ancestor down to targetId.
criteria: Returns an ordered array from root to targetId, or [] if targetId does not exist.
Detects circular parent chains (e.g., A → B → A) and throws an Error instead of looping forever.
Stops cleanly if an intermediate parentId points to a missing node by returning the partial path up to the highest existing node.

title: Type-Safe Immutable Deep Path Updater
prompt: Export setByPath(obj, path, value) plus helper types DotPath<T> and PathValue<T, P> for nested plain objects so invalid paths or mismatched value types fail at compile time while updates stay immutable at runtime.
criteria: Updating a nested leaf returns a new object with the updated value while leaving the input object untouched.
Untouched sibling branches retain exact referential equality (structural sharing).
Invalid dot paths or mismatched value types fail tsc --noEmit (verifiable via @ts-expect-error).
Runtime calls containing "__proto__", "constructor", or "prototype" throw an Error.

title: Strongly Typed Event Bus with Once & Unsubscribe
prompt: Export createTypedBus<Events extends Record<string, unknown>>() providing on, once, off, and emit where listener payloads and void events are strictly checked by TypeScript.
criteria: on and once return idempotent unsubscribe functions; calling unsubscribe twice does not affect other listeners.
A listener added or removed during emit does not disrupt or skip already-registered listeners for that same emission cycle.
Events typed as void can be emitted with one argument (bus.emit("reset")), while payload events fail type-checking if the payload is omitted or wrong.

title: Schema-Driven Record Coercer with Static Type Inference
prompt: Export a minimal schema builder (s.string(), s.number(), s.boolean(), s.optional(inner), s.object(shape)) with an Infer<S> helper type and parse(input: unknown) method returning typed data or structured field errors.
criteria: Infer<typeof schema> produces optional properties (key?: T) for fields wrapped in s.optional and required properties otherwise.
Invalid inputs collect all nested field validation errors with dot-separated paths rather than stopping at the first error.
Unknown extra properties on input objects are stripped from the parsed output rather than leaked through.

title: Fix Async Middleware Composition & Context Typing
prompt: Fix composeMiddleware<Ctx>(middlewares) where calling next() twice inside one middleware silently re-executes downstream handlers, rejected promises are swallowed, and context mutations lose strict typing.
criteria: Middlewares execute in onion order (before next() top-down, after next() bottom-up).
Calling next() more than once within the same middleware rejects with an Error (e.g., "next() called multiple times").
Errors thrown synchronously or asynchronously in downstream middlewares propagate to upstream try/catch blocks.

title: Parallel Dependency Graph Batch Scheduler
prompt: Export planExecutionBatches(tasks: readonly { id: string; dependsOn: readonly string[] }[]): string[][] that groups tasks into the minimum number of sequential execution waves where all tasks in a wave can run in parallel.
criteria: Every task appears in a wave strictly after all of its dependencies, with task IDs sorted lexicographically within each wave for determinism.
Missing dependency IDs or duplicate task IDs throw a descriptive Error.
Cyclic dependencies throw an Error whose message identifies at least one task participating in the cycle.

title: Structural Object Diff & Patch Engine
prompt: Export computeObjectDiff(before, after) and applyObjectDiff(target, ops) for JSON-compatible values supporting add, replace, and remove operations addressed by path segments.
criteria: For any nested plain object pair, applyObjectDiff(before, computeObjectDiff(before, after)) deeply equals after without mutating before.
Distinguishes between a missing key and a key explicitly set to null.
Keys containing dots or slashes (e.g., "a.b") round-trip cleanly because paths are represented as segment arrays or properly escaped tokens.

title: Compile-Time Typed URL Route Matcher
prompt:
Export createRouteMatcher

(pattern: P) that returns a function matching URL paths against patterns like "/orgs/:orgId/repos/:repoId" and extracting URL-decoded parameters with exact inferred keys.
criteria: Static type inference extracts { orgId: string; repoId: string } from "/orgs/:orgId/repos/:repoId" and Record<never, never> when no params exist.
Returns null for mismatched segment counts, wrong static literals, or empty parameter segments.
Percent-encoded segments (e.g., "hello%20world") are decoded safely, and malformed percent encodings return null instead of throwing.

title: Fix Stack Overflow in Deep Freeze Utility
prompt: Fix deepFreezeSafe<T>(value: T): Readonly<T> which currently crashes with a maximum call stack error on cyclic object graphs and ignores symbol-keyed properties.
criteria: Recursively freezes nested plain objects, arrays, and symbol-keyed nested objects.
Handles self-referential and mutually cyclic graphs using a WeakSet without throwing or infinite recursion.
Primitives and null return unchanged without throwing.

title: Type-Safe Finite State Machine Runner
prompt: Export createStateMachine(config) accepting an initial state, a typed transition table mapping states and events to target states with optional guard predicates, and returning getState(), can(event), and send(event).
criteria: send(event) transitions only when the event is valid for the current state and its guard (if present) returns true; otherwise state stays unchanged and send returns false.
can(event) evaluates both transition existence and guard condition without mutating machine state or invoking side-effect hooks.
Passing an undeclared state name in a transition target or an undeclared event to send fails TypeScript compilation.

title: Deep Patch Merger Preserving Built-In Objects
prompt: Export a utility type DeepPatch<T> and function applyDeepPatch<T extends object>(base: T, patch: DeepPatch<T>): T that recursively merges plain objects while treating Date, RegExp, Map, Set, functions, and arrays as atomic replacements.
criteria: Nested plain object fields merge deeply without mutating base or patch.
Arrays, Date instances, and RegExp values in patch replace the base value wholesale instead of merging properties.
DeepPatch<T> does not turn Date or function properties into partial empty objects at compile time.

title: Numeric Interval Coalescer & Subtractor
prompt: Export subtractIntervals(base: readonly [number, number][], cutouts: readonly [number, number][]): [number, number][] working on half-open intervals [start, end).
criteria: Overlapping or touching base intervals (e.g., [0, 5) and [5, 10)) coalesce cleanly before or during subtraction.
A cutout strictly inside a base interval splits it into two disjoint intervals; cutouts covering the entire base yield [].
Empty intervals where start === end are ignored, and inverted intervals (start > end) throw a RangeError.

title: Deterministic Token Bucket Rate Limiter
prompt: Export createTokenBucket({ capacity, refillPerSecond, now }) using an injected clock function now: () => number (ms), exposing tryConsume(cost?: number) returning { allowed: boolean; remaining: number; retryAfterMs: number }.
criteria: Starts full at capacity, refills continuously based on elapsed time from now(), and never exceeds capacity.
When insufficient tokens exist, does not deduct any tokens and returns accurate retryAfterMs rounded up to the nearest millisecond.
Handles clock regressions (if now() moves backwards) gracefully without generating negative tokens or NaN.

title: Branded Minor-Unit Money Arithmetic & Ratio Allocator
prompt: Export branded type Money<C extends string> with money(minorUnits, currency), addMoney(a, b), and allocateMoney(total, ratios) that splits integer cents across weighted ratios with zero penny loss.
criteria: addMoney(money(100, "USD"), money(100, "EUR")) fails TypeScript compilation and also throws a runtime Error if bypassed with casts.
allocateMoney(money(100, "USD"), [1, 1, 1]) returns shares summing exactly to 100 (e.g., 34, 33, 33) using deterministic largest-remainder or sequential penny distribution.
Passing non-integer minor units or all-zero/negative ratios throws a RangeError.

title: Bi-Directional Tree Flattener & Reconstructor
prompt: Export flattenTree<T>(roots: readonly TreeNode<T>[]) and rebuildTree<T>(flat: readonly FlatNode<T>[]) that convert between nested tree structures and flat parent-referenced arrays while preserving sibling order.
criteria: rebuildTree(flattenTree(forest)) deeply equals forest for multi-root, arbitrarily nested trees without mutating inputs.
rebuildTree works even when child records appear earlier in the flat array than their parent records.
Duplicate node IDs or orphan references to nonexistent parent IDs throw an Error.

title: Fix Cache Stampede & Rejected Promise Pinning in Async Memoizer
prompt: Fix memoizeAsync(fn, options) which currently triggers duplicate concurrent calls for the same key before the first resolves, permanently caches rejected promises, and never expires stale TTL entries.
criteria: Concurrent calls for the same key while a fetch is in flight share the exact same pending promise so fn runs only once.
If fn rejects, the key is evicted immediately so subsequent calls retry fresh.
Resolved values expire after ttlMs (using an optional injectable clock) and evict oldest entries when maxEntries is exceeded.

title: Deep Partial Except Specific Keys
prompt: I want a `DeepPartialExcept<T, K>` type that makes all nested properties optional except for a few mandatory root keys (like `id` or `type`). How do I write this cleanly?
must_export: A type named `DeepPartialExcept<T, K extends keyof T>`.
criteria: Keys specified in `K` remain required at the top level of the resulting type.
All other top-level and nested properties become optional.
Passing a key not present in `T` fails compilation.

title: Safe JSON Parse Type Guard
prompt: Is there a clean way to write a type guard or safe JSON parser in TypeScript that validates incoming unknown data against an expected interface without using heavy external schema libraries?
must_export: A function `safeParseJson<T>(raw: string, validator: (val: unknown) => val is T): T | null`.
criteria: Returns the parsed typed object when `validator` returns `true`.
Returns `null` when `JSON.parse` throws a syntax error.
Returns `null` when `validator` returns `false`.

title: Array Chunking Utility with Narrowing
prompt: I'm writing a chunk function in TS that splits an array into chunks of size N, but the return type always widens to `unknown[][]` instead of keeping the item type. How do I fix the types?
must_export: A function `chunkArray<T>(items: readonly T[], size: number): T[][]`.
criteria: Returns an array of arrays where each inner array contains up to `size` items of type `T`.
Throws a `RangeError` if `size` is less than 1.
Preserves the exact item type `T` in the return signature with zero `any` casts.

title: Revealable API Token Display
prompt: Export RevealableToken({ token }: { token: string }) that renders an API token masked with bullet characters (•), provides Show/Hide toggle and Copy buttons, and resets visibility on prop changes.
criteria: An empty token renders "No token provided" with no Show or Copy buttons.
By default renders • repeated token.length times; clicking "Show" reveals the raw token and switches the button label to "Hide".
Clicking "Copy" calls navigator.clipboard.writeText(token), displays "Copied" for 2000 ms, and clears its timer on unmount.
Changing the token prop while revealed automatically re-masks the new token.

title: Character-Limited Bio Editor with Warning Threshold
prompt: Export LimitedTextArea({ maxLength, warnAt, onSubmit }) rendering a textarea, live remaining-character counter, and submit button that blocks over-limit submissions.
criteria: Displays "{remaining} characters left" accurately as the user types, including negative counts if pasted text exceeds maxLength.
Marks the counter with data-state="warning" when remaining characters are at or below warnAt, and data-state="error" when below zero.
Disables the submit button when the trimmed value is empty or exceeds maxLength, and calls onSubmit(value) otherwise.

title: Keyboard-Driven Tag Chips Input
prompt: Export TagChipsInput({ value, onChange }: { value: string[]; onChange: (next: string[]) => void }) allowing users to add trimmed, unique tags with Enter or comma and remove them via button or Backspace.
criteria: Pressing Enter or typing a comma commits the trimmed text, clears the input, and ignores empty or duplicate (case-insensitive) tags.
Pressing Backspace when the text input is empty removes the last tag via onChange.
Each chip includes an accessible remove button (e.g., aria-label="Remove {tag}") that removes only that tag.

title: Accessible Accordion Group
prompt: Export AccordionGroup({ items, allowMultiple = false }) where each item has { id, title, content } and clicking headers expands or collapses panels with proper ARIA attributes.
criteria: When allowMultiple is false, opening one item automatically closes any previously open item; clicking the open header closes it.
When allowMultiple is true, multiple panels can remain open simultaneously.
Each trigger button sets accurate aria-expanded and links to its panel via aria-controls.

title: Fix Controlled/Uncontrolled Desync in Switch Component
prompt: Fix a SwitchControl component accepting optional checked, defaultChecked, and onChange props that currently copies checked into useState once and ignores subsequent parent updates.
criteria: In uncontrolled mode (checked undefined), clicking toggles internal state starting from defaultChecked ?? false and notifies onChange(next).
In controlled mode (checked provided), displayed state always reflects the prop and only changes when the parent updates checked.
Renders with role="switch" and accurate aria-checked attribute in both modes.

title: Synchronized Temperature Converter Inputs
prompt: Export TemperaturePair rendering labeled Celsius and Fahrenheit numeric inputs that stay synchronized while allowing the user to type incomplete inputs like "-" or "" without clobbering their active field.
criteria: Typing "0" in Celsius updates Fahrenheit to "32"; typing "212" in Fahrenheit updates Celsius to "100" (rounded to at most 2 decimals).
Typing an incomplete negative sign "-" or clearing a field preserves the active field's raw text and clears the opposite field rather than displaying "NaN".
Does not reformat the currently edited field while the user is typing (e.g., typing "20." keeps the trailing decimal point).

title: Sortable Metric Table
prompt: Export SortableTable({ rows, columns }) that renders tabular data where clicking a column header sorts ascending, clicking again sorts descending, and clicking a third time restores original order.
criteria: Cycles through ascending → descending → none on repeated clicks of the same column, updating aria-sort on the active <th>.
Clicking a different column header immediately starts that new column in ascending order and resets the previous column's aria-sort.
Numeric columns sort numerically rather than alphabetically, and the original rows prop is never mutated.

title: Live Password Policy Checklist
prompt: Export PasswordPolicyMeter({ onValidChange }) containing a password input and a checklist of four rules: at least 10 characters, an uppercase letter, a digit, and a symbol.
criteria: Each rule item updates its data-passed="true" | "false" attribute immediately as the password changes.
onValidChange(boolean) fires whenever overall validity transitions between invalid and valid, without firing redundantly on every keystroke when validity did not change.
Whitespace-only characters do not count as symbols.

title: Fix Listener Leak in Viewport Breakpoint Badge
prompt: Fix ViewportBadge which attaches a new window resize listener on every render without removing it, fails to initialize from the current window.innerWidth, and misclassifies exact boundary widths.
criteria: Displays "mobile" for < 640, "tablet" for 640–1023, and "desktop" for >= 1024 immediately on initial render.
Updates live when window.innerWidth changes and a resize event fires.
Registers only one resize listener on mount and removes it cleanly on unmount.

title: Guarded Multi-Step Wizard
prompt: Export StepWizard({ steps, onComplete }) where each step defines { id, title, content, isValid?: boolean }, rendering step indicators, Back/Next controls, and a Finish button on the final step.
criteria: Back is disabled on step 1; Next is disabled whenever the current step has isValid === false.
On the last step, the primary button displays "Finish" and invokes onComplete() only when isValid !== false.
Moving backward and forward never lets the active index drop below 0 or exceed steps.length - 1.

title: Debounced Directory Filter
prompt: Export FilterableDirectory({ entries, delayMs = 250 }) displaying a search box and list of people ({ id, name, department }) whose visible results filter case-insensitively after the user pauses typing.
criteria: The search input updates immediately on keystrokes while list filtering waits until delayMs elapses after the last keystroke.
Matches against either name or department, and displays "No matching people" when zero entries match.
Clears any pending debounce timer on unmount and when the user clicks a "Clear" button (which resets immediately without waiting for debounce).

title: Auto-Dismissing Notification Stack
prompt: Export ToastList({ toasts, onDismiss, defaultDurationMs = 4000 }) rendering a list of notifications that auto-dismiss after their duration, support manual dismissal, and pause dismissal while hovered.
criteria: Each toast triggers onDismiss(id) once its duration elapses or when its close button is clicked.
Hovering over a toast (mouseEnter) pauses its countdown, and leaving (mouseLeave) resumes it without firing early.
Toasts with durationMs: 0 persist until dismissed manually.

title: Fix Index-Key State Corruption in Reorderable Notes
prompt: Fix PriorityQueueList({ items }) where each row has an internal draft comment input and Move Up / Move Down buttons, but using array indices as React keys causes typed comments to stay stuck on the wrong row after reordering.
criteria: Moving an item up or down moves both the item label and its local draft comment together.
Move Up is disabled on the first row and Move Down is disabled on the last row.
Deleting a row removes its draft comment without shifting comments onto neighboring rows.

title: Indeterminate Select-All Checkbox Group
prompt: Export SelectAllGroup({ options, selectedIds, onChange }) featuring a master "Select all" checkbox and individual option checkboxes.
criteria: When some—but not all—options are selected, the master checkbox DOM property indeterminate is true and checked is false.
Clicking the master checkbox when none or some options are selected selects all enabled options; clicking when all are selected clears all.
Disabled options are never toggled by clicking "Select all" and do not block the remaining enabled options from reaching the all-selected state.

title: Self-Updating Relative Timestamp Label
prompt: Export TimeAgoLabel({ timestampMs, now = Date.now }) rendering a semantic <time> element showing "just now" (< 60s), "{n}m ago" (< 60m), or "{n}h ago" and refreshing automatically every 30 seconds.
criteria: Formats boundaries accurately (59s → "just now", 60s → "1m ago", 3600s → "1h ago").
Advances its displayed text automatically when fake timers advance without requiring prop changes.
Clears its interval timer cleanly when unmounted.

title: Code Snippet Viewer with Line Range Highlighting
prompt: Export HighlightedSnippet({ code, highlightLines }) where highlightLines accepts strings like "2,4-6", rendering numbered lines with highlighted rows marked via data-highlighted="true".
criteria: Splits both \n and \r\n line endings and numbers lines starting at 1.
Highlights all individual lines and inclusive ranges listed in highlightLines while ignoring out-of-bounds line numbers.
Preserves leading whitespace on indented code lines.

title: Fix Double-Submission in Async Action Button
prompt: Fix SubmitOnceButton({ onAction, label }) where rapid double clicks fire onAction() twice before React re-renders, and a rejected promise leaves the button permanently stuck in a loading state.
criteria: Two synchronous rapid clicks trigger onAction exactly once until the returned promise settles.
Displays "Working..." and sets disabled while pending, then restores label whether the promise resolves or rejects.
Does not attempt to update state if the component unmounts before the promise settles.

title: Undoable Delete List with Per-Item Grace Windows
prompt: Export DeferredActionList({ items, onCommitDelete, graceMs = 3000 }) where clicking Delete starts an independent grace period showing "Deleting..." and an "Undo" button before committing.
criteria: Clicking Undo before graceMs cancels the timer and prevents onCommitDelete from being called.
Staggered deletions run independent timers so undoing one item does not alter another item's deadline.
If onCommitDelete changes identity before a timer fires, the latest callback reference is invoked.
External removal of an item from items or component unmount cancels pending timers so stale deletions never fire.

title: Race-Condition-Safe Async Typeahead Combobox
prompt: Export AsyncAutocomplete({ fetchSuggestions, onSelect }) implementing an accessible combobox with keyboard navigation (ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Enter, Escape) and out-of-order response protection.
criteria: When an earlier slow request resolves after a newer fast request, the stale results are discarded rather than overwriting newer suggestions.
Passes an AbortSignal to fetchSuggestions(query, signal) and aborts the previous request when the query changes or the component unmounts.
Arrow keys move the active option (wrapping cleanly), Enter selects it via onSelect, and Escape closes the listbox.

title: Fix Stale Closure in Precision Stopwatch with Laps
prompt: Fix PrecisionTimer({ now = Date.now }) where pausing and resuming loses accumulated elapsed time, intervals drift because they add fixed 100 ms ticks, and clicking Lap records stale zero deltas.
criteria: Computes elapsed time from now() deltas rather than counting interval ticks, preserving total time across multiple pause/resume cycles.
Clicking Lap records both total elapsed time and the split delta since the previous lap accurately.
Reset stops any active timer, resets elapsed display to 00:00.0, and clears recorded laps.

title: Optimistic Feature Flag List with Rollback
prompt: Export OptimisticFeatureFlags({ flags, onToggle }) where toggling a switch immediately updates the UI, persists via async onToggle(id, nextEnabled), and rolls back with an inline error message if the request fails.
criteria: Clicking a flag reflects the new state synchronously before onToggle resolves.
If onToggle rejects, only that specific flag reverts to its confirmed state and displays an error notice, without disrupting other concurrently toggled flags.
Prevents overlapping requests on the same flag while its toggle is in flight, while allowing independent flags to toggle concurrently.

title: Accessible Modal Dialog with Focus Trap & Restoration
prompt: Export AccessibleModal({ isOpen, onClose, title, children }) rendering a dialog that moves focus inside on open, traps Tab/Shift+Tab within focusable elements, closes on Escape or backdrop click, and restores focus on close.
criteria: Renders role="dialog" with aria-modal="true" and aria-labelledby pointing to the title heading when open, and nothing when closed.
Pressing Tab on the last focusable element wraps to the first, and Shift+Tab on the first wraps to the last.
Closing via Escape or backdrop click invokes onClose and restores focus to the trigger element that held focus before opening.

title: Fix Context Re-Render Cascade in Dashboard Store
prompt: Fix a SplitStoreProvider and its hooks (useUserName, useUnreadCount, useStoreActions) where every counter increment causes unrelated consumer components and action-only buttons to re-render.
criteria: Incrementing unreadCount re-renders only components subscribed to unreadCount, leaving useUserName and useStoreActions consumers with zero additional renders.
Updating userName similarly does not re-render useUnreadCount consumers.
All hooks throw a clear Error when invoked outside SplitStoreProvider.

title: Compound Tabs with Roving Tabindex
prompt: Export compound components Tabs, TabList, Tab, and TabPanel supporting disabled tabs, keyboard arrow navigation, and automatic ARIA linkage.
criteria: Only the active tab has tabIndex={0} while inactive tabs have tabIndex={-1}.
ArrowRight and ArrowLeft move focus and selection across enabled tabs (wrapping at ends and skipping disabled tabs); Home and End jump to the first and last enabled tabs.
Each Tab and matching TabPanel share linked id, aria-controls, and aria-labelledby attributes.

title: Bounded Undo/Redo State Hook
prompt: Export a custom hook useUndoableState<T>(initialValue: T, maxHistory = 50) returning { state, set, undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo, reset }.
criteria: set(next) supports both direct values and functional updaters, discards any redo branch after an undo, and skips pushing a history entry when Object.is(prev, next) is true.
Past history never exceeds maxHistory entries, dropping the oldest snapshot when full.
undo, redo, set, and reset maintain stable function identities across renders (safe in effect dependency arrays).

title: Fix Dependent Dropdown Race Condition
prompt: Fix RegionCityPicker({ regions, fetchCities, onChange }) where switching rapidly from Region A to Region B leaves Region A's cities displayed if A's request resolves second, and keeps an invalid previously chosen city selected.
criteria: Switching regions clears the currently selected city immediately and disables the city select while loading.
Out-of-order responses from earlier region fetches are ignored completely.
If fetchCities rejects, displays an error state with a Retry button that re-fetches only the currently selected region.

title: Cross-Field Form Validator Component
prompt: Export DateRangeForm({ onSubmit }) with start date, end date, and label fields supporting touch-on-blur validation, cross-field ordering checks, and live error clearing.
criteria: Field errors stay hidden until a field is blurred or the form is submitted, then update live as the user corrects values.
Validates cross-field constraint endDate >= startDate and re-validates immediately when startDate changes after endDate is already filled.
On invalid submit, prevents onSubmit, displays all errors linked via aria-describedby, and moves focus to the first invalid input.

title: Fix External Subscription Hook Under React StrictMode
prompt: Fix useExternalSnapshot(store) (where store provides subscribe(cb) and getSnapshot()) which leaks listeners under React StrictMode double-invocation, tears on synchronous updates between render and effect, and crashes when store changes identity.
criteria: Uses useSyncExternalStore (or equivalent tear-safe pattern) so synchronous mutations before commit are never missed.
Re-subscribes cleanly when the store prop switches to a different store instance and unsubscribes from the previous store.
Under <React.StrictMode>, leaves exactly one active subscription while mounted and zero after unmount.

title: Paginated Table with Cross-Page Selection Persistence
prompt: Export PaginatedSelectorTable({ rows, pageSize, onSelectionChange }) supporting page navigation, per-row selection, select-current-page toggle, and a "Clear all ({count})" action.
criteria: Selections made on page 1 persist when navigating to page 2 and back, and onSelectionChange reports all selected IDs across every page.
The header checkbox reflects and toggles only the rows visible on the current page without deselecting rows on other pages.
If the rows prop shrinks so the current page exceeds the new total page count, the active page clamps automatically to the last valid page.

title: Debounced Callback Hook
prompt: Hey, I need a hook that debounces a callback function so it doesn't fire on every keystroke. Can someone write `useDebouncedCallback`?
must_export: A custom hook `useDebouncedCallback<T extends (...args: any[]) => void>(callback: T, delayMs: number): T`.
criteria: Rapid successive calls only invoke the underlying callback once after `delayMs` has elapsed.
If the callback changes between calls, the newest callback is the one that fires.
Unmounting the component clears any pending timers so the callback never fires.

title: Local Storage Synchronized State Hook
prompt: I want a `useLocalStorageState(key, initialValue)` hook that syncs state with browser local storage and updates across tabs when `storage` events fire.
must_export: A custom hook `useLocalStorageState<T>(key: string, initialValue: T): [T, (val: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void]`.
criteria: Reads initial value from `localStorage` or falls back to `initialValue`.
Updates `localStorage` when state setter is invoked.
Listens to window `storage` events and updates state if another tab modifies the same key.

title: Click Outside Detector Hook
prompt: How do I write a simple custom hook `useClickOutside(ref, callback)` that triggers when clicking outside a dropdown or modal element?
must_export: A custom hook `useClickOutside(ref: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, handler: () => void): void`.
criteria: Fires `handler` when a `mousedown` or `touchstart` event occurs outside the referenced DOM element.
Does not fire when clicking inside the referenced element.
Cleans up event listeners on unmount.

title: Infinite Scroll Sentinel Hook
prompt: I'm trying to build infinite scroll using IntersectionObserver. Can someone make a `useInfiniteScroll(onIntersect)` hook?
must_export: A custom hook `useInfiniteScroll(onIntersect: () => void, options?: IntersectionObserverInit): React.RefCallback<Element>`.
criteria: Attaches an `IntersectionObserver` to the returned callback ref element.
Triggers `onIntersect` when the sentinel enters the viewport intersection.
Disconnects the observer cleanly on unmount or ref change.

title: Async Action Status Wrapper
prompt: I need a component or hook that handles loading and error states for an async button click so I don't repeat `try/catch` everywhere.
must_export: A component or hook `useAsyncAction<T>(action: () => Promise<T>): { execute: () => Promise<void>; isLoading: boolean; error: Error | null }`.
criteria: Sets `isLoading` to `true` while the promise is pending.
Captures any thrown error into `error`.
Resets status correctly on subsequent executions.

title: Step Wizard State Hook
prompt: How do I manage multi-step wizard navigation state in React?
must_export: A custom hook `useWizard(totalSteps: number): { step: number; next: () => void; prev: () => void; goTo: (s: number) => void }`.
criteria: Clamps step indices between 0 and `totalSteps - 1`.

title: Recursive File Size Summary by Extension
prompt: Export an async function summarizeByExtension(dirPath: string) that recursively scans a directory and maps each lowercase file extension (e.g., ".ts") to { count: number; bytes: number }.
criteria: An empty directory resolves to {}.
Nested subdirectories aggregate together with normalized lowercase extension keys (A.TS and b.ts merge under ".ts").
Extensionless files and dotfiles like .gitignore group under "(no-ext)".
Symbolic links to files or directories are skipped rather than counted or followed.

title: Atomic JSON File Writer
prompt: Export writeJsonAtomic(filePath: string, data: unknown): Promise<void> that serializes JSON to a unique temporary file in the same directory and atomically renames it over filePath.
criteria: Writes valid pretty-printed UTF-8 JSON with a trailing newline and leaves zero leftover temporary files on success.
If serialization fails (e.g., circular object) or the write fails, the existing file at filePath remains untouched and no stray temp file remains.
Two concurrent calls targeting the same filePath use distinct temp filenames and neither corrupts the final JSON file.

title: Safe Path Containment Resolver
prompt: Export resolveInsideRoot(rootDir: string, userPath: string): string that resolves userPath relative to rootDir and guarantees the resulting absolute path stays strictly inside rootDir.
criteria: Resolves valid relative paths (including normalized internal segments like "a/../b.txt") to an absolute path under rootDir.
Rejects traversal escapes ("../secret"), absolute paths outside root, and null bytes ("\0") by throwing an Error.
Avoids the naive prefix trap: if rootDir is "/srv/app", "../app-backup/data.txt" is rejected rather than falsely accepted.

title: Dotenv File Parser
prompt: Export parseDotEnv(content: string): Record<string, string> supporting KEY=VALUE pairs, blank lines, # comments, optional export prefixes, single quotes, and double-quoted escape sequences (\n, \").
criteria: Handles both \n and \r\n endings, preserves = characters inside values, and strips inline # comments only outside quotes.
Double-quoted values expand \n to real newlines, while single-quoted values treat \n literally.
Unquoted values trim surrounding whitespace while quoted values preserve interior spaces.

title: Fix Unhandled Rejections in Parallel File Reader
prompt: Fix readExistingFiles(paths: readonly string[]) which uses Promise.all and aborts the entire batch when one optional file is missing (ENOENT), while accidentally swallowing permission or directory errors.
criteria: Resolves to a map of path → string for every existing readable file, silently omitting paths that fail specifically with ENOENT.
Re-throws non-ENOENT errors (such as EISDIR when a directory path is supplied).
Never emits unhandled promise rejection warnings.

title: HTTP Health & Readiness Server
prompt: Export createHealthServer(checkReady: () => Promise<boolean>) returning a Node http.Server serving GET /live and GET /ready as JSON.
criteria: GET /live always returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type: application/json and {"status":"ok"}.
GET /ready returns 200 when checkReady() resolves true, and 503 when it resolves false or rejects.
Non-GET methods on /live or /ready return 405 with an Allow: GET header; unknown paths return 404 JSON.

title: Streaming SHA-256 File Checksum
prompt: Export hashFileStream(filePath: string): Promise<string> that computes the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of a file using Node streams and node:crypto without loading the entire file into memory.
criteria: Returns the exact 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 digest for both empty (0-byte) files and multi-megabyte binary files.
Rejects with the underlying filesystem error if the file does not exist or cannot be read.
Closes the file descriptor promptly after completion or error.

title: Zero-Dependency CLI Argument Parser
prompt: Export parseCliArgs(argv: readonly string[], schema) supporting boolean flags (-- verbose, --no-color), valued options (--port 8080, --port=8080), short aliases (-p 8080), positional args, and the -- terminator.
criteria: Parses both --key=value and --key value identically, and treats everything after -- as literal positional arguments even if prefixed with -.
Throws an Error when a declared valued option has no value following it or when an unknown flag is passed.
Returns declared default values for omitted options without mutating argv.

title: Fix Multi-Byte UTF-8 Corruption in Stream Reader
prompt: Fix readUtf8Stream(stream: Readable): Promise<string> which calls chunk.toString("utf8") on each incoming Buffer chunk and corrupts emoji or CJK characters split across chunk boundaries.
criteria: Correctly reconstructs multi-byte UTF-8 characters (such as 4-byte emoji) split across 1-byte buffer chunks without emitting replacement characters (\uFFFD).
Handles empty streams by resolving to "".
Rejects immediately if the readable stream emits an error event.

title: Sequential Log Filename Allocator
prompt: Export nextLogFilePath(dirPath: string, dateStr: string): Promise<string> that inspects existing files matching app-{YYYY-MM-DD}.{N}.log and returns the next unused sequence path starting at 1.
criteria: Returns app-2026-05-01.1.log when no logs exist for that date.
Finds the numeric maximum rather than lexicographic maximum (so after .9.log and .10.log, it returns .11.log).
Ignores unrelated files and logs from other dates in the same directory.

title: HTTP JSON Endpoint with Strong ETag Caching
prompt: Export createConfigHandler(getConfig: () => unknown) returning a Node HTTP request listener that serializes the config, computes a quoted SHA-256 ETag, and handles If-None-Match conditional requests.
criteria: Returns 200 with Content-Type: application/json, ETag, and the JSON body on normal requests.
Returns 304 Not Modified with an empty body and the matching ETag header when If-None-Match matches (including comma-separated ETag lists or *).
Returns 200 with a fresh ETag as soon as getConfig() returns modified content.

title: Directory Snapshot Diff Utility
prompt: Export compareDirectories(dirA: string, dirB: string) returning { added: string[]; removed: string[]; modified: string[] } of sorted POSIX relative file paths by comparing actual file contents.
criteria: Identifies files present only in dirB as added, only in dirA as removed, and present in both with differing byte content as modified.
Files with identical bytes but different modification timestamps are not reported as modified.
Returns sorted forward-slash relative paths across nested subdirectories.

title: Fix Cross-Platform Archive Path Normalizer
prompt: Fix normalizeArchivePaths(rawPaths: readonly string[]): string[] which leaves Windows backslashes, leading slashes, and duplicate separators in tar/zip entry names and fails to reject parent traversal entries.
criteria: Converts all backslashes to forward slashes, collapses duplicate slashes, and strips leading ./ or / prefixes.
Throws an Error if any normalized entry contains a .. segment or a Windows drive prefix like C:.
Deduplicates identical normalized entries while preserving first-seen order.

title: Bounded Retry Helper with Exponential Backoff
prompt: Export retryWithBackoff(fn, options) accepting maxAttempts, baseDelayMs, optional shouldRetry(err), optional signal: AbortSignal, and injectable sleep(ms).
criteria: Resolves immediately on the first successful attempt and doubles delay between failures (baseDelayMs * 2^(attempt - 1)).
Stops immediately and re-throws when shouldRetry(err) returns false or when maxAttempts is exhausted.
Aborts cleanly without further attempts if signal is already aborted or aborts during backoff sleep.

title: Single-Pass Stream Line & Byte Counter
prompt: Export measureStream(readable: Readable): Promise<{ bytes: number; lines: number }> that counts total raw bytes and logical lines in a single pass without buffering the full stream in memory.
criteria: An empty stream resolves to { bytes: 0, lines: 0 }.

Counts both trailing-newline files ("a
b
" → 2 lines) and files without a final newline ("a
b" → 2 lines) accurately across arbitrary chunk splits.
Counts multi-byte UTF-8 characters by byte length rather than JavaScript string code unit length.

title: Fix Listener Leak in Event-Based Timeout Wrapper
prompt: Fix waitForEventWithTimeout(emitter, eventName, timeoutMs) which leaves timers dangling after the event fires, leaves event listeners attached after timeout, and ignores "error" events emitted before resolution.
criteria: Resolves with the emitted payload if eventName fires before timeoutMs, clearing the timer and removing all attached listeners.
Rejects with a timeout Error when timeoutMs elapses and removes both eventName and error listeners from the emitter.
Rejects immediately with the emitted error if the emitter emits "error" before eventName, leaving zero listeners behind.

title: Streaming NDJSON Batcher with Error Isolation
prompt: Export createNdjsonBatchStream({ maxBatchSize, onInvalidLine }) returning a Transform stream (readableObjectMode: true) that parses chunked UTF-8 NDJSON and emits arrays of up to maxBatchSize values.
criteria: Handles JSON lines and multi-byte UTF-8 characters split across arbitrary Buffer boundaries as well as \n and \r\n endings.
Emits full batches immediately when filled and flushes any partial batch (including a final line lacking a trailing newline) on stream end.
Invalid JSON invokes onInvalidLine(rawLine, lineNumber) with 1-based line numbers without crashing the stream; blank lines are ignored.
Non-integer or < 1 values for maxBatchSize throw a RangeError.

title: Bounded-Concurrency Async Pool with AbortSignal
prompt: Export runTaskPool<T, R>(items, concurrency, worker, options?: { signal?: AbortSignal }) that runs at most concurrency workers simultaneously and returns results in the exact input order.
criteria: Active in-flight workers never exceed concurrency, and the returned array aligns index-for-index with items regardless of completion order.
When a worker rejects or signal aborts, no further queued items are started and the pool rejects with the triggering error or abort reason.
Invalid concurrency (< 1 or non-integer) throws a RangeError synchronously; empty items resolves to [].

title: Fix Backpressure & Flush Drop in Transform Stream
prompt: Fix createLinePrefixStream(prefix: string) which pushes lines inside a tight loop ignoring downstream backpressure, drops the last line when no trailing newline exists, and doubles prefixes when a line spans multiple chunks.
criteria: Prefixes every logical line exactly once—even when lines span multiple small chunks or arrive many per chunk.
Flushes the final line cleanly when the input ends without a trailing newline, and emits nothing for a 0-byte input.
Cooperates cleanly with stream.pipeline into a slow writable stream with a tiny highWaterMark without unbounded memory growth or data loss.

title: Graceful HTTP Server Shutdown Controller
prompt: Export attachGracefulShutdown(server: http.Server, { drainTimeoutMs }) returning a shutdown(): Promise<void> function that stops accepting new connections, lets active requests finish, sends Connection: close on keep-alive responses, and force-closes stalled sockets after drainTimeoutMs.
criteria: In-flight HTTP requests started before shutdown() complete normally with their full response before the server closes.
Idle keep-alive connections are closed promptly so shutdown() does not hang waiting for socket timeouts.
Calling shutdown() multiple times concurrently returns the same promise and force-destroys lingering sockets once drainTimeoutMs expires.

title: Fix Symlink Escape & Range Bug in Static File Server
prompt: Fix createSafeFileServer(rootDir: string) which currently lets URL-encoded traversal (%2e%2e) or symlinks pointing outside rootDir serve arbitrary host files, and mishandles HEAD requests.
criteria: Resolves real filesystem paths (via realpath) and returns HTTP 403 for both path traversals (including percent-encoded) and symlinks targeting files outside rootDir.
Returns 200 with accurate Content-Length for GET, and returns identical headers with zero body bytes for HEAD.
Returns 404 for missing files or directories (never dumping raw directory handles or crashing the server).

title: Sliding-Window Per-Client HTTP Rate Limiter
prompt: Export createRateLimiter({ windowMs, maxRequests, keyFn, now }) returning a handler wrapper that enforces a sliding request window per client key and sets standard rate-limit headers.
criteria: Allows up to maxRequests within any rolling windowMs interval per client key, returning HTTP 429 with an accurate integer Retry-After header (in seconds) once exceeded.
Sets X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining headers accurately on both allowed and blocked responses.
Evicts expired client buckets automatically so memory does not grow unbounded under rotating client keys.

title: Fix Stream Error & Cleanup Bug in Gzip File Compressor
prompt: Fix compressFileSafe(srcPath: string, destPath: string) which uses manual .pipe() chains, leaving half-written corrupted .gz files behind when the source read fails or an AbortSignal cancels compression mid-flight.
criteria: Compresses srcPath into valid gzip output at destPath that decompresses byte-for-byte back to the original file.
On read error, write error, or AbortSignal cancellation, destroys all streams, rejects with the cause, and removes any partial file at destPath.
Never overwrites a pre-existing valid file at destPath if compression aborts partway through.

title: HTTP Idempotency-Key Deduplication Middleware
prompt: Export createIdempotencyWrapper({ ttlMs, now }) wrapping an async HTTP handler so retried POST requests with the same Idempotency-Key replay the stored status, headers, and body without re-running the handler.
criteria: Two identical concurrent requests sharing an Idempotency-Key execute the handler only once and both receive the same response.
Reusing an existing key with a different request body hash returns HTTP 409 Conflict instead of replaying or re-executing.
If the handler fails with HTTP 5xx or throws, the key is not permanently locked so clients can safely retry.

title: Fix Stampede & Stale Mtime Bug in Async File Cache
prompt: Fix createFileCache({ maxBytes }) which re-reads the same file concurrently on cold misses, fails to invalidate entries when the file's size or mtimeMs changes on disk, and ignores its maxBytes LRU budget.
criteria: Concurrent reads for an uncached file coalesce into a single disk read while returning fresh copies or immutable buffers.
Automatically reloads from disk when a cached file's mtimeMs or byte size changes.
Evicts least-recently-used entries so total cached byte weight never exceeds maxBytes (files larger than maxBytes bypass caching instead of evicting everything endlessly).

title: In-Process Job Queue with Retries & Dead-Letter Routing
prompt: Export createJobQueue({ concurrency, maxRetries, processor, onDeadLetter }) supporting enqueue(payload), drain(), and stats() with isolated per-job retry tracking and graceful draining.
criteria: Processes up to concurrency jobs in parallel and retries failing jobs up to maxRetries times before routing permanently failed jobs to onDeadLetter(job, lastError).
drain() resolves only after all queued, in-flight, and retried jobs have reached a terminal completed or dead-lettered state.
stats() accurately reports { queued, active, completed, deadLettered } at any point without ever leaking negative counts.

title: Safe JSON File Reader
prompt: Need a helper that reads a JSON file and returns `null` or default if the file is missing or malformed.
must_export: A function `readJsonSafe<T>(filePath: string, fallback: T): Promise<T>`.
criteria: Returns parsed JSON or `fallback` if `ENOENT` occurs or JSON parsing fails.

title: Safe Unlink Helper
prompt: How do I delete a file in Node without throwing an error if the file doesn't exist?
criteria: Deletes file and returns `true`, or returns `false` if `ENOENT` occurs.

title: Stream Buffer Collector
prompt: How do I consume a readable stream into a single Buffer helper function?
criteria: Collects all chunks into a unified Buffer.

title: CSV Line Parser
prompt: How do I parse a single CSV row string handling quoted fields containing commas?
criteria: Splits CSV fields correctly respecting double quotes.
